description: This file is a shell script for performing revision history rewriting in Git repositories, providing various filtering and modification functions for commits, files, and tags. It appears to be a utility for advanced history rewriting, possibly an adaptation of 'git filter-branch'.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to stderr.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a commit or object id to its rewritten form, or returns it unchanged if not mapped.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Function intended to skip a commit during rewriting by printing its mapped parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a non-empty tree, or skips empty trees.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Ensures author/committer identity variables are set and exported.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer info from a commit and prepares identifier variables.
